comparison.scope: Unchanged historical outcomes; exposed retrospective probes and repeat-opening costs only

validation: **29 distinct selected Java checks and 164 desktop checks passed**, with no failures or skipped cases. The final nine focused Java checks include the missing-history refusal and unchanged diagnostic scoring. The broader Java regression passed before that narrow read-only guard was added. Two actual app studies cover one exposed camera case and two exposed generated controls. The installed build receipt matches current compiled inputs. This is a scoped regression, not a rerun of every historical system capability.
finding: The shifted/rotated camera return remains unresolved: **11/42 correct observations, 31 missing, 0/30 hidden outputs and 0 matches to the labelled red lighter**, exactly as in edition150. Read-only probes explain why; they do not add recovered observations. Reopening the unchanged verified comparison took **0.127 seconds median**, versus **129.227 seconds** for its cold full replay. Defaults and tracking thresholds remain unchanged.
